note: Every file format commitwork treats as a public interface (docs/STABILITY.md), and whether it is frozen. A frozen format's schema is pinned by its last history line; bin/test/format-freeze.test.mjs fails on a shape change until a line is appended. Non-frozen entries are the remaining gap, listed so it stays visible.

formats.summary: The per-area batch digest the daily suggestions run reads.

history.note: Pinned when the format freeze began.

Optional repos[].advice: cobolwork's advice document for the swept revision (state read, with its items in summary.ordered order) or why there is none (state unavailable). The property is optional and nothing else moved, so every earlier digest still validates.

history.note: Pinned when the format freeze began.

Optional advice: per repo whose cobolwork lane ran, the suggestion list cobolwork's advice document gives in its order, or why there was none. The property is optional and nothing else moved, so every earlier report still validates.

formats.summary: The issue tracker store: hash-chained events and derived issue state.

history.note: Pinned when the format freeze began.
llm.engine accepts anthropic and openai-compatible; optional llm.host names the server that answered.

Event types issue-snoozed and issue-unsnoozed; optional nullable snoozedUntil on an open issue (feed triage, 42e78dd6). Classified from the diff: the enum only gains values and the field is optional, so every earlier store still validates.

Optional source.ruleTitle (the rule's own description, rule-level metadata) and evidence tier worktree-copy (an issue keyed on a worktree copy closed as superseded). Classified from the diff: a new optional property and an enum that only gains a value, so every earlier store still validates.

formats.summary: The cross-area digest bin/digest.mjs builds and delivers.

history.note: Pinned when the schema was written from bin/digest.mjs.

Optional sections.returnedWarnings (set-aside warnings seen again in the window, with the set-aside beside them) and an optional key on ratchet-breach and failed-work items. Both are optional, so every earlier digest still validates.

Failed work gains the item type scheduled-job-failed (a failed step of a run recorded in the scheduled job journal) and the undetermined source scheduled job journal. Both widen an enum, so every earlier digest still validates.

formats.summary: The per-operator read and snooze state of the Inbox, written under a lock by monitor/inbox.mjs.
formats.gap: No schema file. readInboxState checks the schema stamp and that entries is an object; the entry shape (readAt, snoozedUntil, at) is not described anywhere a reader can validate against.

formats.summary: Each lane's raw report in a run directory, read back through monitor/extractors.mjs.
formats.gap: Each report is its scanner's own shape; commitwork stamps no version and the extracted rows have no per-lane schema.

formats.summary: The check manifests under manifests/ and repo-local commitwork.json.
formats.gap: A schema exists; a manifest carries no version field, so a reader cannot refuse a shape it does not know.

formats.summary: The CRA evidence pack cra/pack.mjs writes: markdown documents and an index.
formats.gap: Markdown with no version marker and no description of the files a pack must contain.

formats.summary: The suggestions document the daily model run returns.
formats.label: commitwork.daily-suggestions/1
formats.gap: Named in the prompt and validated against a schema; the document itself carries no version field.

formats.summary: The tool names and input schemas the MCP server lists.
formats.gap: No version a client can read. The listed shapes are pinned by fingerprint, so a change fails the freeze test.

formats.summary: commitwork's findings as SARIF, one log per scanned repository.
formats.gap: The upstream schema is not vendored. run.properties.commitwork has no schema; partialFingerprints are pinned by bin/test/finding-identity-pin.test.mjs.
